rubrics.justification: Generally consistent with the reported 3AA grade, but the image itself does not clearly support a precise AA-level ICM/TE assessment; some described details (well-defined ICM location, cohesive TE circumferentially, thinning at specific poles, perivitelline fragments/polar bodies) are somewhat over-interpreted from this single image.
Thoroughly integrates age, AMH/DOR, oocyte yield and maturity, male factor/partner age, BMI, endometrium, first-cycle status, and lifestyle factors with embryo prognosis and future planning.

Reasoning is structured and mostly logical, with a clear link from morphology and patient factors to prognosis; minor issues include somewhat overstated effects of stress/alcohol/former smoking and a few speculative assumptions.

Mostly aligned on embryo grading, DOR context, luteal support, and counseling, but includes recommendations with weaker guideline support or controversy (ERA after one failure, growth hormone, DHEA/CoQ10, TESE based on DFI concerns, embryo banking before transfers).

Provides clear practical steps for transfer optimization and future-cycle planning, including counseling and male-factor workup; slightly reduced by inclusion of several nonstandard or weak-evidence interventions.
